text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I think I'll pass
on going to the shopping mall this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I have some work I want to get done.
Ask me out again next time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No! You've had more races lately, after all.
Look forward to the souvenirs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... My legs feel so heavy.
For now, shaking off this fatigue is my top priority.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is all for the next victory... ...I'm confident...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be building up fatigue from running so many races.
We should reconsider her upcoming schedule.
